title: inline after complete
name: Inline after complete — NN/g
rule: Prefer inline validation after the user finishes a field; do not show an error before input is complete or on fields they have not reached.

citation.source: NN/g — 10 Design Guidelines for Reporting Errors in Forms (§1, §7)

pass_when: Field error can appear after the user finishes that field (blur/complete), without a full-form submit as the only path; no error while still typing that field; untouched later fields stay quiet.
fail_when: Errors only after full submit; or error appears mid-keystroke on the active field; or untouched fields are marked invalid.
overview: Show field errors after the user finishes a field, not while typing or untouched.
apply_when: Timing inline validation on blur or complete before or with submit.
not_when: Submit-time summary that also pairs with finished-field inline errors.
agent_hint: Validate after the field is finished; stay quiet mid-keystroke and on untouched fields.
description: Prefer inline validation after the user finishes a field. Do not show an error before input is complete, mid-keystroke on the active field, or on fields they have not reached. A full-form submit should not be the only path to see a field error. Fail errors only after full submit with no finished-field path, mid-keystroke errors on the active field, or untouched fields marked invalid.
